name: Lazy Sweep Ray Casting
definition: A fast algorithm for rendering general irregular grids based on the sweep-plane paradigm, accelerating ray casting by exploiting spatial coherence and handling disconnected/nonconvex grids.
summary: Lazy Sweep Ray Casting is a fast algorithm for rendering irregular grids that exploits spatial coherence by sweeping a plane to maintain an active cell list, replacing expensive 3D ray casting with simpler 2D regular grid traversal.
